description: Sets out the main ways to enforce a money judgment, costs order or costs certificate in England and Wales side by side: warrant of control, transfer up and writ of control, attachment of earnings…

court.description: The court that made the judgment or order: "county" (the County Court), "high" (the High Court).

orderDate.description: The date of the judgment, or of the costs order (interest on costs runs from it).

sum.description: The sum still unpaid under the judgment, order or certificate, without judgment interest, in…

what.description: What is being enforced: "judgment" (a money judgment), "costs" (a costs order or costs certificate).

name: check_enforcement_options
title: Enforcement options calculator (writ, warrant, charging order, TPDO, attachment of earnings)
